text:
alex (PM): quick huddle — we need to pick an order for Optimize toolkit rollout: quantization, batching, caching. customer asks piling up, limited eng sprints.

emma (Eng): +1. can we avoid redoing infra between items? sequencing matters.

brian (ML): posting quick RICE-ish thoughts:
- quantization: Reach=mid (40%), Impact=high (lower GPU cost ~30%), Confidence=medium (3/5), Effort=3 sprint-people -> RICE ~ (40*30*3)/3 ~= 1200 (ballpark)
- batching: Reach=high (60%), Impact=medium (latency/throughput trade), Confidence=high, Effort=4 -> RICE ~ higher for throughput workloads
- caching: Reach=low-mid (30%), Impact=high for tail latency, Confidence=low (eviction/consistency), Effort=2 -> tricky to compare

alex (PM): thanks. two constraints: 1) enterprise pilot requires quant by EOY for cost reasons, 2) several PLG users want batching for noisy short prompts.

jia (ProdOps): ops note: batching touches request routing & autoscaler configs; quant touches model packaging and infra validation. caching needs edge-work (redis/prefix store) and clear invalidation policy.

emma (Eng): proposal: split into two tracks: Core Serving (quant + batching infra) and Edge Enhancements (caching + prefix/KV cache later). That reduces rework.

brian (ML): agree. suggested MVP scopes:
- quant MVP: static 8-bit conversion + perf regression check + quantized model artifacts in registry
- batching MVP: simple fixed-window batching + metrics to tune batch size; no dynamic batching first
- caching MVP: prefix-only read-through cache, TTL 1m, opt-in per-customer

alex (PM): launch criteria idea: each feature needs (a) perf SLO improvement or cost saving validated on 2 customers or load tests, (b) no >5% model-quality regression on eval set, (c) docs + SDK example. Thoughts?

emma (Eng): reasonable. add safety: rollback plan for each (quick toggle via feature-flag).

jia (ProdOps): add monitoring: per-route token cost delta, tail latency, cache hit/miss. Also an alert on model-regression metric.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: quant-mvp -> canary on dedicated cluster tonight (automated note). :rocket:

brian (ML): last call on priority: if enterprise sales pushes quant, push quant first; otherwise, batching yields better PLG retention. We should gate by sales cadence.

alex (PM): decision: prioritize quant -> batching -> caching for Q2 roadmap but keep caching as a small tactical spike (1 sprint) to validate feasibility. if sales locks on batching, we re-evaluate. I'll convert this into a short RICE doc and share. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
